note: Re-baselined on integration-6 (Waves 0-3 + version review merged): the previous figures (502 scripts, 9020885 bytes) were taken when only Wave 0 and part of Wave 1 existed. Waves 1-3 added about 180 blocking scripts for features that are off for existing profiles. This is a measured baseline, not an allowance: the 15 percent growth limit applies from here, and moving the off-by-default features to VexBoot.LATE_MODULES (each needs its app.js bootStep to run after the module loads) is the way to bring it down.
markNote: marksMs and domNodes were measured on 2026-10-17 from source on the maintainer machine (seeded profile, probe harness). domNodes follows the same 15 percent growth rule as the scripts; marksCapMs are loose ceilings (about four times the measurement) for a slow CI runner: they catch a start-up that went wrong, not a few percent. scripts/verify-smoke-boot.js reads the SMOKE: BOOT line of the real boot and holds it against them.
